t: AI Semantic Web Ontology: Ontology Builder — Simple
name: AI Semantic Web Ontology: Ontology Builder — Simple
title: AI Semantic Web Ontology: Ontology Builder — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A builder that turns a domain's documents into a formal ontology: it extracts candidate concepts, proposes relations, and presents them to domain experts for approval. The machine proposes; the expert disposes.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Concept-set diversity across 4096 concepts = 12.0 bits. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Semantic Web Ontology & Contextual Understanding (Chapter)
real_world_basis: Semi-automated ontology learning is standard in knowledge engineering.
signature_version: Signature version: the understanding Balance assessor — the chapter's A7 Balance (breadth vs depth) scored per ontology, with the 'universal' framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: extract candidates first, get expert approval per relation, and version every change.
math_note: Concept-set diversity across 4096 concepts: 12.0 bits [verified]; Expert-review audit at 95%, p=0.12: 23 samples [verified]
safety: Quality safety: unreviewed extractions are quarantined — nothing enters the ontology without expert approval.
how_it_works: Documents feed concept extraction; relation proposals queue for expert review; approved triples enter the ontology with provenance. The demo recomputes the diversity bits of the concept set and the audit sample for expert review.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time

t: AI Semantic Web Ontology: Entity Linker — Simple
name: AI Semantic Web Ontology: Entity Linker — Simple
title: AI Semantic Web Ontology: Entity Linker — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A linker that resolves mentions to entities: 'Paris' the city vs 'Paris' the person, decided by context with a confidence score. Every link carries its evidence — the context features that decided it.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Linking update: prior 0.5, lik 0.9, marg 0.6 = 0.7500 posterior. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Semantic Web Ontology & Contextual Understanding (Chapter)
real_world_basis: Entity linking is deployed in search, news, and finance at massive scale.
signature_version: Signature version: the understanding Totality assessor — mentions resolved vs unresolved as a computed ratio, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: build the entity catalog first, calibrate confidence on labeled data, then link with evidence.
math_note: Linking update: prior 0.5, lik 0.9, marg 0.6: 0.7500 posterior [verified]; Service link: 100 MHz at SNR 12: 370.0 Mbps [verified]
safety: Accuracy safety: low-confidence links are flagged, never silently asserted.
how_it_works: Mentions with context feed the disambiguator; the linker outputs entity plus confidence and evidence. The demo recomputes the Bayes linking update and the Shannon capacity of the linking service.

t: AI Semantic Web Ontology: Context Resolver — Simple
name: AI Semantic Web Ontology: Context Resolver — Simple
title: AI Semantic Web Ontology: Context Resolver — Simple
description:
[REAL ENGINEERING] A resolver that tracks what 'it', 'that', and 'there' mean as discourse unfolds: it maintains the entity stack, resolves references per turn, and flags ambiguity instead of guessing. Guessing wrong about 'it' breaks everything downstream.

Start here. In plain terms: Headline number: Reference entropy at p=0.6 = 0.9710 bits. The rest of this record keeps every number honest — each claim below was recomputed, not copied.
chapter_source: Architecting Solutions: Building AI for Universal Semantic Web Ontology & Contextual Understanding (Chapter)
real_world_basis: Coreference and discourse resolution are standard NLP components.
signature_version: Signature version: the understanding First/Last assessor — discourse open (first mention) and close (final resolution) tracked per conversation, with the framing labeled concept.
build_steps: Build: maintain the entity stack explicitly, resolve with confidence, and flag ambiguity to the user.
math_note: Reference entropy at p=0.6: 0.9710 bits [verified]; Resolver latency: 3 stages x 120 ms: 360 ms [verified]
safety: Clarity safety: when confidence is low, the resolver asks — it never guesses silently on ambiguous references.
how_it_works: Dialogue turns update the entity stack; the resolver links each reference with confidence. The demo recomputes the entropy of the reference distribution and the latency budget of the resolver.
requirements: Re-run the demo program to re-verify every number
standards: Full-file record, never a stub
Speculative = Signature-labeled, never as established fact
Every numerical claim recomputed at build time
